shared_elements: low-relief carving on a pale monolithic stone slab/pillar
animal figure rendered in profile in shallow relief
arm or limb-like appendage carved along the stone face
rough excavated stone rubble surrounding the carved block
flat undecorated ground left around raised motifs
justification: Both show pale, coarse-grained monolithic blocks bearing shallow, schematic relief creatures with rounded heads and limb-like elements, carved so the background is left plain and rough, and both sit amid unworked rubble. The decisive difference is composition: A carries a single small animal and an arm running vertically down a narrow pillar shaft, whereas B presents an organised horizontal scheme of three arched motifs above a hatched band and a register of animals, a register logic entirely absent in A.
